comment: Written by generators/standards (sensescases) from RFC 5545 at its pinned bytes and app/specs/senses/clocks.json: do not edit. Each example is a 'flat' request of the senses guest and its answer at one pinned clock. The time zone is the TZID of the RFC's VTIMEZONE example; the event under way and the next one are chosen among the VEVENTs of the RFC's iCalendar objects that give DTSTART and DTEND in UTC, with their UID, start and end as the RFC prints them, written as RFC 3339.
examples:
flat
base https://example.com/me/
now 1996-09-18T15:00:00Z
zone America/New_York
event 1996-09-18T14:30:00Z 1996-09-20T22:00:00Z uid1@example.com
next 1997-03-24T12:30:00Z 1997-03-24T21:00:00Z uid3@example.com
timeZone America/New_York
scheduleNow 1996-09-18T14:30:00Z/1996-09-20T22:00:00Z uid1@example.com
scheduleNext 1997-03-24T12:30:00Z/1997-03-24T21:00:00Z uid3@example.com
flat
base https://example.com/me/
now 1997-07-14T16:00:00Z
zone America/New_York
next 1997-07-14T17:00:00Z 1997-07-15T04:00:00Z 19970610T172345Z-AF23B2@example.com
timeZone America/New_York
scheduleNext 1997-07-14T17:00:00Z/1997-07-15T04:00:00Z 19970610T172345Z-AF23B2@example.com
